tools.name: find_airports
tools.description: Look up 3 letter IATA airport codes by city, airport or country name.

tools.name: search_flights
tools.description: Find one-way flights to use as an onward ticket. Returns up to 10 flights, each with an id to buy and its price in USD.

tools.name: buy_ticket
tools.description: Buy the ticket for a flight from search_flights, paid in USDC. Call it first without payment to get the price, wallet address and MPP challenges.
